title: The Kiss
source: Pinacoteca di Brera, Milan (public domain). Wikimedia Commons: El Beso (Pinacoteca de Brera, Milán, 1859).jpg (6329 x 7885 px)
caption: Why is he hiding his face? #romance #italianhistory #hayez #masterpiece #hiddenmessage
_verify: VERIFIED, Wikipedia EN (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Kiss_(Hayez)): 1859, Pinacoteca di Brera, commissioned by Count Alfonso Maria Visconti di Saliceto (given to the Brera 1886); read as a tribute to the alliance between France and the Kingdom of Sardinia against Austria, blue and red tones echoing the French flag; ambiguous metaphors to avoid censorship, couple not identifiable; a dagger hidden in the man's cloak suggests rebellion; his foot on the step suggests he is about to leave, she grips him tightly; shadowy forms on the left suggest conspiracy and danger; symbol of the ideals of Italian unification; later versions 1861 (white dress) and one with a green cloak.
GENERAL (low risk): in 1859 Italy was not yet unified; Lombardy (Milan) was under Austrian rule until June 1859.

slides.headline: Why is he hiding his face?
Milan, 1859
slides.text: Milan, 1859. Italy is not yet one country, and the north is ruled by Austria. Censors watch every painting. Then Hayez paints a kiss.

slides.headline: A medieval kiss
slides.text: A young couple in medieval clothes, in a stone hallway. It looks like a simple love scene. But nothing here is simple.

slides.headline: Hidden face
slides.text: His face is hidden under his hat. We never learn who he is. Hayez made the couple impossible to identify, on purpose.

slides.headline: One foot on the step
slides.text: Look down: his foot is already on the step. He is not arriving. He is leaving, maybe for good.

slides.headline: Her grip
slides.text: She holds him tightly, as if she knows it. This is not a first kiss. It is a farewell.

slides.headline: The shadow
slides.text: And on the left, a dark figure lurks in the corridor. Someone is watching them. Danger, a conspiracy, a secret.

slides.headline: The colours
slides.text: Now the colours: her blue, his red. Many read them as the French flag, Italy's new ally against Austria. A political message.

slides.headline: A secret message
slides.text: It became a symbol of Italian unity. Some even see a dagger hidden in his cloak. Love story, or call to arms?
